name: Chicagoland (Chicago and the North Shore suburbs)
comment: Sample cells are 1000 m x 1000 m boxes (+-500 m) around named public anchors (parks, plazas, stations). `center` is the anchor's Overpass `out center` position rounded to 4 decimals, written by `regionkit.sh anchors`. `near` is only a disambiguation hint for same-named features. Places live here (data), never in tool code.

zones.name: Evanston (North Shore)
zones.templateReason: Closest existing vocabulary that is NOT the scored reference: detached 1-2 storey suburban houses with steep gabled (Cape/Colonial-like) and broad ranch families, no alleys assumed (regions-v1 northeast-suburbs). The town profiles in docs/proposals/regions-chicagoland-miami are the comparison references, never templates.
missingFamilies: Generator support for the reference families' identity (cross-gables, dormers, steep Tudor roofs with chimneys, broad Prairie eaves, turrets): the profiles now name them, but BuildingGenerator renders one gabled/hipped/flat roof per rectangle
raised ranch / split-level (half-levels are rounded by the generator)
courtyard apartments (role block always takes the first flat-roof type)

anchorResolved.rule: Overpass `out center`, rounded to 4 decimals; cell = centre +- radiusMeters

cells.extraReason: Second Evanston sample, inside the evanston-inland-review box of docs/proposals/regions-chicagoland-miami/region-catalog.json (the Lovelace Park anchor cell lies outside that box). Smith Park is the public park nearest the box centre (42.0485, -87.691), chosen from `regionkit.sh find --bbox 42.037,-87.699,42.060,-87.683 --tag leisure=park`.

zones.name: Chicago dense north side (Lakeview, Lincoln Park, Edgewater)
zones.templateReason: Front-range is the only profile with flat-roof 2-3 storey families (modern, duplex) plus a steep gabled cottage, the nearest vocabulary for two/three-flats and frame workers' cottages on narrow lots. Its bungalow/foursquare/ranch families will mostly be filtered out by aspect/levels.
missingFamilies: Role dispatch for apartments: buildings with role `block` (building=apartments, yes >= 250 m2, ...) always use the FIRST flat-roof house type, so sixFlat / courtyardMass / cornerMixedUse / vintageHighRise in the reference profiles are never chosen for them
two/three-level rear porches and gangways, stoops, cornices (no geometry support)
Chicago brick bungalow attic/dormer and raised basement (one roof per rectangle, no dormers)
